title: From leather to a shell, in 21 moments
lede: Fifty-six years of Coleco and the afterlife of its name. Filter by thread.

events.title: Connecticut Leather
events.text: Maurice Greenberg founds the Connecticut Leather Company.

events.title: Coleco
events.text: The company changes its name to Coleco.

events.title: ColecoVision
events.text: Coleco enters video games; 560,000 consoles ship in North America that year.

events.title: Sales nearly triple
events.text: $510.4M of sales and $44.9M of profit; electronics are 73% of sales.

events.title: Adam and the Kids
events.text: Coleco announces a home computer and introduces the Cabbage Patch Kids in the same month.

events.title: Adam ships
events.text: Late and with early faults; about 95,000 ship in 1983.

events.title: A loss
events.text: A $7.4M net loss, driven by Adam costs in the fourth quarter.

events.title: Adam abandoned
events.text: The remaining stock is sold at a loss to an unnamed retail chain.

events.title: $79.8M loss
events.text: Including $118.6M on disposing of the Adam; equity falls to $10.5M.

events.title: Record year
events.text: $776.0M of sales, $600M of it Cabbage Patch Kids; net earnings $82.9M.

events.title: Layoffs
events.text: 100 more jobs cut in Connecticut as doll sales slow and Rambo toys disappoint.

events.title: Tomy USA
events.text: Coleco buys the U.S. arm of the Japanese toy maker.

events.title: The doll halves
events.text: Cabbage Patch sales fell to about $250M in 1986, Coleco says.

events.title: $105.4M loss
events.text: For 1987, on sales of $504.5M.

events.title: Losing licenses
events.text: Trivial Pursuit is going to Tonka; 475 jobs go and the chairman resigns.

events.title: Chapter 11
events.text: Filed in New York: $384.3M of assets, $540.3M of liabilities.

events.title: Sold to Hasbro
events.text: The court approves the $85M sale of nearly all remaining assets.

events.title: Ranger Industries
events.text: The plan takes effect; old shares are canceled and the shell keeps $950,000.

events.title: The name returns
events.text: River West Brands acquires the Coleco trademark.

events.title: Coleco Sonic
events.text: A $50 handheld with 20 Sega games goes on pre-order.

events.title: Chameleon canceled
events.text: Coleco Holdings ends the console project before any product ships.
